ABSTRACT This column highlights recently published articles that are of
interest to the readership of this publication. We encourage ABRF
members to forward information on articles they feel are important and
useful to Clive Slaughter, AU-UGA Medical Partnership, 1425 Prince
Avenue, Athens GA 30606. Tel; (706) 713-2216: Fax; (706) 713-2221:
Email; cslaught@uga.edu or to any member of the editorial board. Article summaries reflect the
reviewer’s opinions and not necessarily those of the Association.
